title: The Grunion Run, x
logline: Tenth year. Forty thousand readers and half of them want to know if it's real. Wood draws the fish, the buckets, the hands. It's real.

panels.composition: The beach, lanterns, the run. The chorus is a crowd now, twenty stick figures along the bluff with signs: IS THIS REAL · WHERE IS THIS · SMALL WOOD ISN'T ON THE MAP.

characters.pose: twenty on the bluff with signs

image.prompt: a night beach festival with lanterns and a coffee line, and along the bluff above twenty small stick figures holding crude signs, muddy watercolor and ink
image.notes: Signs: IS THIS REAL / WHERE IS THIS / SMALL WOOD ISN'T ON THE MAP. Letter after.

panels.composition: Wood, to the bluff, not turning.

balloons.text: It's real. It's not on the map. Both things are the point.

image.prompt: close-up of a man with a drawing pad speaking without turning toward a bluff, lantern light

panels.composition: The pad: the fish, the buckets, the hands, in three strokes each. The tenth year's drawing.

image.prompt: close-up of a drawing pad with silver fish, buckets and reaching hands sketched in quick confident strokes

panels.composition: Silent. The fish. The lanterns. The stick figures on the bluff have stopped holding signs and are just watching. Wood, pad closed.

image.prompt: silent wide night beach panel of a surf line alive with silver fish under lanterns, stick figures on the bluff standing without signs just watching, a man with a closed pad, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm

notes: 'It's real. It's not on the map.' The chorus stops asking.
